title: Mayer–Vietoris long exact sequence for two open subschemes
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let U,V be open subschemes of X whose union is W. For every quasi-coherent module F on W [pqf-def-coherent] there is a long exact sequence of cohomology groups [pqf-def-cohomology] \(0\to H^0(W,F)\to H^0(U,F)\oplus H^0(V,F)\to H^0(U\cap V,F)\to H^1(W,F)\to\cdots\to H^{p-1}(U\cap V,F)\to H^p(W,F)\to H^p(U,F)\oplus H^p(V,F)\to H^p(U\cap V,F)\to\cdots\) for all p\ge0 (with H^{-1}=0), in which H^p(W,F)\to H^p(U,F)\oplus H^p(V,F) is the pair of restriction maps and H^p(U,F)\oplus H^p(V,F)\to H^p(U\cap V,F) is the difference of the restriction maps. The sequence is natural in F (a morphism F\to F' of quasi-coherent modules on W induces a morphism of long exact sequences) and natural in inclusions of open covers: for an open W'\subseteq W with U'=U\cap W' and V'=V\cap W', the restriction maps H^p(T,F)\to H^p(T\cap W',F|_{W'}) for T\in\{W,U,V,U\cap V\} form a morphism from the sequence of (W,U,V,F) to the sequence of (W',U',V',F|_{W'}), commuting also with the connecting maps.

source.place: Cohomology of Sheaves, Lemma 01EB (cohomology-lemma-mayer-vietoris), stated there for any O_X-module on a ringed space; naturality under restriction to an open from its proof (restriction of an injective resolution to an open is an injective resolution)

proof.text: Apply the ringed-space Mayer–Vietoris node to the ringed space underlying W, the open cover U∪V=W, and the O_W-module F. Its long exact sequence is exactly the displayed sequence after identifying the restrictions of F to U, V, and U∩V with the indicated quasi-coherent modules. The maps are the restriction maps and their difference, and the node's naturality in F gives the asserted naturality for morphisms of quasi-coherent modules. Applying its restriction clause to an open W'⊂W gives U'=U∩W', V'=V∩W' and the asserted morphism of long exact sequences, including the connecting maps.
